commit.message:
feat(intake): generate AlertHub e2e test prompts

Runs the intake parse-prd flow against the AlertHub PRD + architecture
to generate 30 tasks and their prompt files.

Generated:
- prd.json — 30 parsed tasks with decision points and dependencies
- .tasks/docs/task-{1..30}/prompt.md — markdown task prompt
- .tasks/docs/task-{1..30}/prompt.xml — XML task prompt
- .tasks/docs/task-{1..30}/acceptance.md — acceptance criteria

Agent mapping:
- Bolt (Kubernetes): Tasks 1-8 (infrastructure)
- Rex (Rust/Axum): Tasks 9-16 (notification router)
- Nova (Bun/Elysia+Effect): Tasks 17-22 (integration service)
- Grizz (Go/gRPC): Tasks 23-26 (admin API)
- Blaze (React/Next.js): Tasks 27-28 (web console)
- Tap (Expo): Task 29 (mobile)
- Spark (Electron): Task 30 (desktop)
